title: 'Omar calls a general levy after the defeat at the Bridge
description: At Medina 'Omar received the news of Abu 'Obeid's defeat calmly, comforted the fugitives who had returned there, and sent out a fresh cry for a levy en masse across the Peninsula. Bands arriving at Medina asked to go to Syria, but 'Omar sent every available man to Al-'Irak, winning over Jarir's levy with the promise of one-fourth of the royal fifth of booty taken in Persia. Dated to the year 0634 by the source.

sources.citation: Sir William Muir, The Caliphate: Its Rise, Decline, and Fall, "A. IT. 13-14."
